name: Descript
shortDescription: Edit video and audio by editing the transcript. Pricing page included a free-to-start option.
longDescription: Descript edits audio and video from the transcript. The pricing crawl included free-to-start or hobby and $0 language, with paid samples in a roughly $16–$65 range. Confirm current limits on the pricing page. We did not install the app.
bestFor: Cutting and cleaning talking-head or podcast video
Creators who edit by editing words
